messages:
maria_support: heads up — customer reporting ~5% of mobile traffic being routed to eu-pop instead of us-west. big latency spikes and billing bump. customer id 98765, sample req id a1b2c3. logs attached below.
ben_ops: can you paste the request headers + any proxying layer traces?
maria_support: pasted from mobile capture and from our LB (not redacted):
```
# original client -> upstream
X-Region: us-west
User-Agent: Redwood-Mobile/2.3.1
X-Request-Id: a1b2c3

# after nginx LB -> router
X-Region: us-west|
User-Agent: Redwood-Mobile/2.3.1
X-Request-Id: a1b2c3
```
carlos_router: interesting — router treats X-Region as a CSV/pipe-delimited list and picks the *last* non-null token as highest priority. if the value list ends with an empty token we end up interpreting that as an explicit empty region which triggers fallback->nearest-pop (in many cases eu). i haven't seen a trailing pipe concat pattern before.
diane_infra: that matches a recent nginx snippet we deployed in 2024-11 to join multiple header values: we used a small lua/concat helper that does join(values, "|"). bug is it doesn't trim empty values when an upstream sends an extra empty header value (some proxies add an empty header on retry). I'll open a revert/patch now.
ben_ops: can we reproduce locally? what curl do you use to test?
sam_devex: repro steps I used:
1) curl -v -H "X-Region: us-west" -H "X-Region: " https://api.redwood.test/endpoint
2) observe LB forwarding header "X-Region: us-west|"
3) router log shows parse -> tokens ["us-west", ""] -> picks last token -> empty -> fallback route -> eu-pop

sam_devex: temporary mitigations:
- add router rule to prefer first non-empty token when parsing multi-value regions (low-risk config change)
- patch nginx concat helper to filter out empty strings before join (will be done in next patch)
- ask customer to stop sending duplicate X-Region header (client SDK fix)

carlos_router: I'll add the router rule as a hotfix. can one of infra deploy a quick nginx patch to trim empties in the join helper to avoid recurrence?
diane_infra: creating infra ticket INF-2024-867, scheduling emergency patch to staging now and prod if green. estimated 45m. infra-bot will post deploy events.
infra-bot: deploy pipeline triggered for nginx-concat-fix (staging) — build 2024.11.8. status: queued
ben_ops: FYI metrics: we saw ~0.8% of total requests this window hit eu-pop, latency +120ms p95 for those requests. customer on phone, they want ETA.
maria_support: told customer 1hr rolling hotfix, escalation email sent. keeping thread updated. :thumbsup:
sam_devex: follow-up note for postmortem: add unit test for multi-value header joiner and update SDK to not emit duplicate empty header entries on retries. also add a metric to track header parse fallback events.
maria_support: thanks all — marking as in-progress. will post update when infra-bot shows staging success.
